protocol.timer: steady/perf_counter wall; Metal GPUStartTime..GPUEndTime after completion
protocol.timing_excludes: I/O, fixture/synthetic generation, handle setup and cached template preparation
protocol.algorithm_wall_includes: FFT proposal, pose generation, C ABI, packing, growth, GPU submission/wait/readback, selection/refinement
protocol.memory: process RSS high-water includes Python/NumPy/driver/setup; explicit owned buffer bytes are separate; Metal allocations share RAM and MUST NOT be added to RSS
protocol.scope: micro: fixed pose batches; registration: supplied single ROI, NOT full-image detection
protocol.accuracy: accept NCC >= .8, TP requires <=1px, <=1deg, <=1% relative scale; unmatched accepted output is FP
protocol.fft: NumPy CPU FFT external backend; no GPU FFT implementation
protocol.cuda: not implemented or benchmarked; no CUDA device on this host
